a: Deha kol chad vechad kelal uferat beappe nafsheh darshinan leh; aval ofot – la!
Im ken, nichtov rachamana chad perata!

He nichtov rachamana? i ketav rachamana "shor", hava amena: karev legabbe mizbeach – in, sheen karev legabbe mizbeach – la. vei ketav rachamana "chamor", hava amena kadosh bivchora – in, sheen kadosh bivchora – la!
Amri: im ken, nichtov rachamana "shor vachamor", "se" lema li? shema minna leetoye ofot.
Veema leetoye ofot tehorim – dumeya dese, dimtamme begadim abbet habbelia; aval ofot temeim – delet behu tumea, dela metammei begadim abbet habbelia, la! "kol" – ribbuya hu.
Vechol hecha dichtav "kol" – ribbuya hu? veha gabbe maaser, dichtiv "kol", veka darshinan leh bichlal uferat!

Detanya: "venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teavve nafshecha" – kalal, "babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar" – parat, "uvechol asher tisholcha nafshecha" – chazar vechalal; kelal uferat uchelal – i atta dan ella keen happerat, ma happerat meforash – peri mipperi vegiddule karka, af kol peri mipperi vegiddule karka.
Amri: "bakkol" – kelala, "kol" – ribbuya hu. veibbaet ema: "kol" – kelala hu, mihu "kol" dehacha – ribbuya hu.
Mikkede ketiv meikkara kelal uferat uchelal – dichtiv: "ki yitten ish el reehu" – kalal, "kesef o chelim" – parat, "lishmor" – (hadar) [chazar] vechalal;
Vei salka datach hay "al kol devar pesha" name lichlal uferat hu daata, nichtov rachamana lehane perate gabbe haych kelal uferat; "al kol devar pesha" lema li? shema minna: ribbuya hu.

Hasheta deamrat "kol" – ribbuya, kol hane perate lema li? chad lemaote karka, vechad lemaote avadim, vechad lemaote shetarot. "salma" – lemaote davar sheeno mesuyyaym, "al kol aveda" – lechidrabbi chiyyay bar abba, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hattoen taanat gannav
b: Baaveda, meshallem tashlume chefel; shenneemar: "al kol aveda asher yomar".
Tenan hatam: "hechan pikdoni?" amar leh: "avad", "mashbiacha ani", veamar: "amen"; vehaedim meidim oto sheachalo – meshallem et hakkeren. hoda al pi atzmo – meshallem keren vachomesh veasham.
"Hechan pikdoni?" amar lo: "nignav", "mashbiacha ani", veamar: "amen"; vehaedim meidim oto sheggenavo – meshallem tashlume chefel. hoda meatzmo – meshallem keren vachomesh veasham.

Katane miha betoen taanat gannav dimshallem tashlume chefel – aval betoen taanat avad la meshallem tashlume chefel. vaafillu toen taanat gannav – bishvua hu dimshallem tashlume chefel, aval shello bishvua eno meshallem tashlume chefel.
Menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "im yimmatze haggannav" – betoen taanat gannav hakkatuv medabber.
Atta omer betoen taanat gannav – o eno ella begannav atzmo? keshehu omer: "im lo yimmatze haggannav" – betoen taanat gannav hakkatuv medabber.

Tanya iddach: "im yimmatze haggannav" – begannav atzmo hakkatuv medabber. atta omer begannav atzmo, o eno ella betoen taanat gannav? keshehu omer: "im lo yimmatze haggannav" – hare toen taanat gannav amur, ha ma ani mekayyem: "im yimmatze haggannav"? begannav atzmo hakkatuv medabber.
Dechulle alma mihat, "im lo yimmatze haggannav" – betoen taanat gannav ketiv. may mashma? amar rava: "im lo yimmatze" kema sheamar, ella shehu atzmo genavo – yeshallem shenayim.
Umenalan devishvua?
Detanya: "venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim" – lishvua. atta omer lishvua, o eno ella ledin? neemar shelichut yad lematta, veneemar shelichut yad lemala; ma lehallan lishvua, af kan lishvua.
Bishlama leman deamar chad begannav vechad betoen taanat gannav – hayeynu dichtivi tere kerae; ella leman deamar tarvayyhu betoen taanat gannav, tere kerae lema li?
Amri: chad lemaote taanat avad.
Uleman deamar chad begannav vechad betoen taanat gannav, dela meyaytar, lemaote taanat avad mena leh? miggannav–haggannav".
Uleman deamar tarvayyhu betoen taanat gannav, demayet leh toen taanat avad, "gannav–haggannav" may daresh beh?

Amar lach: mibbee leh lechidrabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan – deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon – meshallem tashlume chefel. tavach umachar – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.
Leman deamar chad begannav vechad betoen taanat gannav, dehay "gannav–haggannav" appekeh lemaote taanat avad, derabbi chiyyay bar abba mena leh?
Amar lach: hekkesha hu, veen meshivin al hekkesha.
Bishlama leman deamar chad begannav vechad betoen taanat gannav – shappir, ella leman deamar tarvayyhu betoen taanat gannav – gannav atzmo mena leh?
Vechi tema: lete bekal vachomer mittoen taanat gannav; dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon, ma lehallan bishvua – af kan bishvua!
Nafka leh middetana deve chizkiyya, detana deve chizkiyya: yeamer "shor" ugeneva" – vehakkol bakkelal!
Illu kach, hayiti omer: ma happerat meforash – karev legabbe mizbeach, af kol karev legabbe mizbeach. ma yesh lecha lehavi – se,

a: Keshehu omer "se" – hare se amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "geneva"? lerabbot kol davar.
Yeamer "shor", "se" ugeneva", vehakkol bakkelal! illu kach, hayiti omer: ma happerat meforash – davar hakkadosh bivchora, af kol davar hakkadosh bivchora.
Ma yesh lecha lehavi – chamor, keshehu omer "chamor" – hare chamor amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "geneva"? lerabbot kol davar.
Yeamer "shor" vachamor" "se" ugeneva" – vehakkol bakkelal! illu kach, hayiti omer: ma happerat meforash – baale chayyim, af kol baale chayyim.
Ma yesh lecha lehavi – shear baale chayyim, keshehu omer "chayyim" – hare chayyim amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "geneva"? lerabbot kol davar.
Amar mar: yeamer "shor" ugeneva". mi ketiv "shor" ugeneva"? "geneva" vashor" hu dichtiv!

Vechi tema "illu neemar" kaamar – illu neemar "shor" ugeneva"; umi matzet amrat "ma happerat meforash"?! have "shor" perat ugeneva" kelal; perat uchelal – naasa kelal mosif al happerat, veitrabbu lehu kol mille!

Ella kedichtiv kaamri – "geneva" veshor". mi matzet amrat "hakkol bakkelal", o "ma happerat meforash"? have leh "geneva" kelal veshor" perat; kelal uferat – en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat; shor in, midde acharina la!
Amar rava: tanna achayyim" ka samech leh, uchelal uferat uchelal kaamar leh.
Veha la dame kelala batra lichlala kamma! ha tanna – deve rabbi yishmael hu, dichhay gavvna daresh kelale uferate.
Vehachi ka kashya leh: "im himmatze timmatze" lema li? yeamer "shor" ugeneva" vechayyim" – vehakkol bakkelal!

Illu ken, hayiti omer: ma happerat meforash – davar hakkarev legabbe mizbeach, af kol hakkarev legabbe mizbeach. ma yesh lehavi – "se", keshehu omer "se" – hare se amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "geneva"? lerabbot kol davar.
Yeamer "geneva" veshor" vase" vechayyim" – vehakkol bakkelal! illu ken, hayiti omer: ma happerat meforash – davar hakkadosh bivchora, af kol davar hakkadosh bivchora.
Ma yesh lecha lehavi – chamor, [keshehu omer "chamor"] hare chamor amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "geneva"? lerabbot kol davar.
Yeamer "geneva", veshor", vase", vachamor", vechayyim" – vehakkol bakkelal! illu ken, hayiti omer: ma happerat meforash – baale chayyim, af kol baale chayyim.
Ma yesh lecha lehavi – shear baale chayyim; keshehu omer "chayyim" – hare chayyim amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "geneva"? lerabbot kol davar; "im himmatze timmatze" lema li?
b: I hachi, shappir kashya leh!
Mishshum deit leh pircha: lerabbot kol davar mehecha kamayyte leh – mikkelal batra; kelala gufeh "chayyim" ketiv beh!
Kelal uferat uchelal may ka mahane leh? i leetoye kol davar, ha "chayyim" ketiv – baale chayyim in, midde acharina la! mishshum hacha itzterich "im himmatze".
Amri: veha shene chelalot dismichi ahadade ninhu! amar ravina, kidamri bemareva: kol makom sheatta motze shene chelalot hassemuchim ze laze – hattel perat benehem, vedunem bichlal uferat.

Shedi "shor" ben "himmatze" letimmatze" – leetoye may? i leetoye baale chayyim, mechayyim" nafka! ella leetoye davar sheen baale chayyim, uderosh hachi: ma happerat meforash – davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon, af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon.
Vetu shedi "chamor" ben "himmatze" letimmatze" – leetoye may? i leetoye davar sheen baale chayyim, mishshor nafka! ella leetoye davar mesuyyaym.
I hachi, "se" lema li? ella ribba umiet veribba hu, kidtana deve rabbi yishmael.
Detana deve rabbi yishmael: "bammayim" "bammayim" shete peamim – en ze kelal uferat, ella ribba umiet veribba; ribba hakkol.

May rabbi – rabbi kol mille? i hachi, kol hane perate lema li? chad lemaote karka, vechad lemaote avadim, vechad lemaote shetarot. "geneva" vechayyim" – lechidrav, deamar: achayay lekeren keen shegganav.
Uleman deamar chad begannav vechad betoen taanat gannav, vegannav atzmo nafka leh meim yimmatze haggannav", hay "im himmatze timmatze" may daresh beh?

Mibbee leh lechidrava bar ahilay, deamar rava bar ahilay: may tama derav, deamar: mode biknas veachar kach bau edim – patur? dichtiv: "im himmatze timmatze" – im himmatze beedim, timmatze bedayyaynim; perat lemarshia et atzmo.
Uleman deamar tarvayyhu betoen taanat gannav, dehay "im himmatze timmatze" mappek leh legannav atzmo, marshia atzmo menalan? measher yarshiun elohim" – velo hammarshia et atzmo.
Uleman deamar chad begannav vechad betoen taanat gannav, deayyti leh mehimmatze timmatze" lemarshia et atzmo, hay "asher yarshiun" may daresh beh? amar lach: hahu mibbee leh lemode biknas – defatur.
Uman deamar tarvayyhu betoen taanat gannav, kasavar: mode biknas veachar kach bau edim – chayyayv.
Uleman deamar chad begannav vechad betoen taanat gannav, denafka leh gannav mehatam; bishlama "im himmatze timmatze" – lechidrava bar ahilay. aval kol hane perate, lema li?
Kidtana deve rabbi yishmael – detana deve rabbi yishmael: kol parasha shenneemra venishnet, lo nishnet ella ledavar shennitchaddesh bah.
Veema gannav atzmo bishvua!
La salka datach; detanya, rabbi yaakov omer: "shenayim yeshallem" – shello bishvua. atta omer shello bishvua, o eno ella bishvua? amarta lo kach haya.

May "lo kach haya"? amar abbaye: la lichtov rachamana "shenayim yeshallem" begannav, velete bekal vachomer mittoen taanat gannav – uma toen taanat gannav, divhettera ata lideh, amar kera lishallem tere; gannav atzmo, divissura ata lideh, lo kol shekken?!
Ella "shenayim yeshallem" dichtav rachamana begannav atzmo, lema li? daafillu shello bishvua.
Vehay "im himmatze" – lehachi hu daata? ha mibbee leh lechidtanya: "yado" –

a: En li ella yado, gaggo chatzero vekarpefo minnayin? talmud lomar: "im himmatze timmatze" mikkol makom!
Im ken, lema kera o "himmatze himmatze" o "timmatze timmatze"; middeshanni kera, shema minna tarte.
Gufa – amar rav: keren – keen shegganav. tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha – kishat haamada baddin.
May tama derav? amar kera: "geneva" vechayyim". ammay kaamar rachamana "chayyim" bigneva? achayay lekeren keen shegganav.
Amar rav sheshet: amena, ki nayem veshachev rav amar leha shemata. detanya: kechusha vehishminah – meshallem tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha keen shegganav.
Amri, mishshum daamar leh: "ana pattemna veat shaklat?!"
Ta shema: shemena vehichchishah – meshallem tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha keen shegganav!
Hatam name – mishshum deamrinan leh: ma li katla kulla, ma li katla palga. ki kaamar rav – beyukera vezula hu dekaamar.

Hechi dame? illema demeikkara shavya zuza, ulevassof shavya arbea zuze – keren keen shegganav; lema peliga derav adderabba? deamar rabba: hay man digzal chavita dechamra mechavreh, meikkara shavya zuza ulevassof shavya arbea zuze, tavra o shatyay – meshallem arbea[5]. ittevar mimmela – meshallem zuza.
Amri: ki kaamar rav – kegon demeikkara shavya arbea[5] ulevassof shavya zuza; keren – keen shegganav, tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha – kishat haamada baddin.

Tane rabbi chanina lesayyoeh lerav: baal habbayit shettaan taanat gannav befikkadon, venishba, vehoda, uvau edim – im ad shello bau edim hoda, meshallem keren vachomesh veasham; veim mishshebbau edim hoda – meshallem tashlume chefel veasham, vechumesho ole lo bichfelo; divre rabbi yaakov.
b: Vachachamim omrim: "berosho vachamishitav"; mamon hammishtallem berosh – mosif chomesh, mamon sheen mishtallem berosh – en mosif chomesh. rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: en chomesh veasham mishtallem bemakom sheyyesh kefel.
Katane mihat: chumesho ole lo bichfelo, divre rabbi yaakov. hechi dame? illema demeikkara shavya arbea ulevassof shavya arbea, chumesho ole lo bichfelo?!
Kefela arbea, vechumesha zuza! ella lav demeikkara shavya arbea, ulevassof shavya zuza, dichfela zuza vechumesheh zuza?
Alma keren keen shegganav, tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha kishat haamada baddin!

Amar rava: leolam demeikkara shavya arbea vehasheta name shavya arbea, udeka kashya: kefela arbea vechumesheh zuza, hacha bemay askinan – kegon shennishba vechazar venishba arba peamim, vehoda; vehattora amra "vachamishitav" –
Hattora ribbeta chamishiyyot harebe bekeren achat.
Amar mar, vachachamim omrim: "berosho vachamishitav" – mamon hammishtallem berosh mosif chomesh, mamon sheen mishtallem berosh en mosif chomesh. aval asham – mayyte,
May shena chomesh dela meshallem – dichtiv: "berosho vachamishitav", asham name la meshallem – deha ketiv: "berosho vachamishitav", "veet ashamo"!
Amri lach rabbanan: "et" paskeh kera.
Verabbi shimon ben yochay – "veet" arveh kera. verabbanan amri lach: la lichtov rachamana la vav velo "et".
Verabbi shimon ben yochay amar lach: "et" la saggi dela ketav – leafsoke ben mamon gavoah lemamon hedyot; hilkach ata vav arveh kera.
Amar rabbi ila: ganav tale venaasa ayil, egel venaasa shor – naasa shinnuy beyado, ukenao. tavach umachar – shello hu toveach, shello hu mocher.

Etiveh rabbi chanina lerabbi ila: ganav tale venaasa ayil, egel venaasa shor – meshallem tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha, keen shegganav. vei salka datach kanyeh beshinnuy, ammay meshallem? shello hu toveach, shello hu mocher!
Amar leh: veella may, shinnuy la kane? ammay meshallem keen shegganav? leshallem ki hasheta!

Amar leh: ki hasheta hayeynu tama dela meshallem – mishshum daamar leh: "tora genavi mimmach?" "dichra genavi mimmecha?" amar leh: rachamana naytztzelan mehay data! amar leh: adderabba, rachamana naytztzelan middata didach!
Matkef la rabbi zera: venikninhu beshinnuy hashshem!
Amar rava: shor ben yomo karuy "shor", ayil ben yomo karuy "ayil". shor ben yomo karuy "shor" – dichtiv: "shor o chesev o ez ki yivvaled".
Ayil ben yomo karuy "ayil" – dichtiv: "veele tzoncha lo achalti" – elim hu dela achal, kevasim achal?! ella lav shema minna ayil ben yomo "karuy" ayil?
Mikkol makom kashya! amar rav sheshet: ha manni – bet shammay hi, deamri: shinnuy bimkomo omed(400), vela kane.

Detanya: natan lah beetnannah chittin vaasaan solet, zetim vaasaan shemen, anavim vaasaan yayin; tane chada asur, vetane chada muttar. veamar rav yosef, tane gureyon demeasporak: bet shammay osrin, uvet hillel mattirin.
May tama devet shammay? dichtiv: "gam" – lerabbot shinnuyehem. uvet hillel – "hem" velo shinnuyehem.
Uvet shammay – hahu

a: "Hem" velo valdotehem hu daata. uvet hillel – tarte shemait minna: "hem" velo shinnuyehem, "hem" velo valdotehem. uvet hillel, hachtiv "gam"! "gam" levet hillel kashya.

Ad kan la peligi, ella demar savar: shinnuy kone, umar savar: en shinnuy kone; aval leinyan shallome – kulle alma kidmeikkara meshallem, dekatane: meshallem tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha keen shegganav.

Lema tehve teyuveta derav, deamar rav: keren – keen shegganav meshallem, tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha – kishat haamada baddin? amar rava: telaim – kidmeikkara, damim – keshel achshav.
Amar rabba: shinnuy kone – ketiva utenena. ketiva – "veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal", ma talmud lomar "asher gazal"? im keen sheggazal – yachazir, veim lav – damim bealma bae shallome.
Tenena – haggozel etzim vaasaan kelim, tzemer vaasaan begadim – meshallem kishat haggezela.
I name – lo hispik litteno lo ad shetztzevao, patur. alma shinnuy kone.
Yeush – amri rabbanan denikne, mihu la yadinan i deorayyta i derabbanan.
I deorayyta – midde dahava ammotze aveda; motze aveda lav kevan demiyyayash mara minna mikkamme detete lideh, kane leh? hay name, kevan dimyayesh mara, kane leh. alma kane.
O dilma la damya laaveda, aveda hu dechi atay lideh – behettera atay lideh; aval hay, kevan divissura atay lideh – midderabbanan hu;
Daamur rabbanan nikne, mippene takkanat hashshavim.
Verav yosef amar: yeush eno kone, vaafillu midderabbanan.
Etiveh rav yosef lerabba: gazal chametz veavar alav happesach,
b: Omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha". vehay, kevan dimta iddan issura – vadday miyyayash; vei salka datach yeush kone, ammay omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha"? deme mealleya bae shallome leh!
Amar leh: ki kaamena ana – ze mityayesh veze rotze liknot; hay – ze mityayesh veze eno rotze liknot.
Etiveh abbaye lerabba: "korbano" – velo haggazul. hechi dame? illema lifne yeush, lema li kera? peshita!
Ella lav leachar yeush? shema minna yeush la kane!
Amar leh rava: velitamaych, ha detanya: "mishkavo" – velo haggazul,
Hechi dame? illema digzal amra veavdeh mishkav, mi ikka leman deamar shinnuy maase la kane? ella may it lach lememar – digzal mishkav dechavreh; hachi name – digzal korban dechavreh.
Etiveh abbaye lerav yosef: orot shel baal habbayit – machshava metammeatan.
Veshel abbedan – en machshava metammeatan.
Shel gannav – machshava metammeatan, shel gazlan – en machshava metammeatan.
Rabbi shimon omer: chilluf haddevarim – shel gazlan machshava metammeatan, veshel gannav en machshava metammeatan; lefi shello nityayashu habbealim.
Ushema minna, yeush kone! amar leh: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shekkitztzean.
Matkef la rabba bar rav chanan: vahalo itzba shanu kan, veitzba en tzericha kitztzua!
Ditnan: kol makom sheen chesron melacha – machshava metammeato, yesh chesron melacha – en machshava metammeato; chutz min haetzva.
Ella amar rava: hay milleta keshi ba rabba lerav yosef esrin vetarten shenin, vela ipparka ad deyatev rav yosef beresha, ufarka: shinnuy hashshem – keshinnuy maase dame.
Shinnuy maase may tama – hatam meikkara etzim, hasheta kelim; shinnuy hashshem name – meikkara karu leh "mashka", vehasheta "abbarzin".
Vahare marish – deikka shinnuy hashshem, demeikkara "keshura" vehasheta "telala"; utenan: al hammarish haggazul shebbenao bevira shennotel damav, mippene takkanat hashshavim.
Tama mippene takkanat hashshavim,

a: Ha lav hachi – hadar beeneh! amar rav yosef: marish – shemo alav, detanya: "tzalot habbayit" – ellu hammaltetin, "vehaubbim" – ellu hammerishot.
Rabbi zera amar: shinnuy hachozer livriyyayto – beshinnuy hashshem – la have shinnuy.
Veshinnuy hashshem sheeno chozer livriyyayto, mi have shinnuy? vahare tzinnor – demeikkara "ketzitzta" vehasheta "tzinnora", vetanya: tzinnor shechakako ulevassof kevao – posel et hammikve.
Kevao ulevassof chakako – eno posel et hammikve.
Vei amrat shinnuy hashshem milleta hi, afillu kevao ulevassof chakako name lifsol!
Shane sheiva, demidderabbanan hi. i hachi, afillu deresha name! hatam ikka torat keli alav betalush, hacha en torat keli alav betalush.
Metivi: haggannav vehaggazlan vehaannas – hekdeshan hekdesh, uterumatan teruma, umaserotan maaser.
Amri: hatam ikka shinnuy hashshem – demeikkara "tivla" vehasheta "teruma", hekdesh meikkara "chullin" vehasheta "hekdesh".

Amar rav chisda amar rabbi yonatan: minnayin leshinnuy shehu kone? shenneemar: "veheshiv et haggezela" – ma talmud lomar "asher gazal"? im keen sheggazal – yachazir, veim lav – damim bealma bae shallome.
Hay "asher gazal" mibbee lemaote gezel aviv, sheeno mosif chomesh al gezel aviv!
Im ken, nichtov rachamana "veheshiv et gezelo", "asher gazal" lema li lemichtav? shema minna tarte.

Veikka deamri, amar rav chisda amar rabbi yonatan: minnayin leshinnuy sheeno kone – shenneemar: "veheshiv et haggezela" – mikkol makom. veha ketiv: "asher gazal"! hahu mibbee leh – al gezelo shello mosif chomesh, veen mosif chomesh al gezel aviv.
Amar ulla: minnayin leyeush sheeno kone? shenneemar: "vahavetem gazul et happisseach veet hachole" – gazul dumeya defisseach, ma pisseach delet leh takkanta kelal,
b: Af gazul delet leh takkanta; la shena lifne yeush, vela shena achar yeush.
Rava amar mehacha: "korbano" – velo haggazul. emat? illema lifne yeush – peshita, lema li kera?
Ella lav leachar yeush – ushema minna yeush la kane? shema minna.
Veha rava hu deamar digzal korban dechavreh! ibbaet ema: hadar beh, veibbaet ema: chad minnayyhu rav pappa amra.
Umiddat tashlume arbaa vachamishsha vechulei.
Veammay? nelaf "shor"–"shor" mishshabbat – ma lehallan chayya veof kayyotze bahen, af kan chayya vaof kayyotze bahen!
Amar rava, amar kera: "shor vase" "shor vase" shene peamim – shor vase in, midde acharina la.

Amri: he meyaytar? ilema "shor vase" desefa meyaytar, denichtov rachamana: "ki yignov shor o se utevacho umecharo, chamishsha vakar yeshallem tachtav vearba tzon tachtav"; i ketav rachamana hachi, hava amena bae shallome tisha lechol echad veechad!
Vechi tema ha ketiv "tachtav" "tachtav" – chad "tachtav" meyaytar;
Hahu mibbee leh lidrasha acharina – detanya: yachol ganav shor shave mane, yeshallem tachtav [chamishsha] negidin? talmud lomar: "tachtav" "tachtav".
Ella "shor vase" deresha meyaytar – denichtov rachamana: "ki yignov ish utevacho umecharo, chamishsha vakar yeshallem tachat hashshor, vearba tzon tachat hasse".
I ketav rachamana hachi, hava amena: ad deganev tere vetavach lehu! "utevacho" ketiv – lechad.
Veema: ad deganev tarvayyhu umezabben lehu! "umecharo" ketiv – lechad.
Veema: have amena ad deganev tere, vetavach chad umezabben chad! "o mecharo" ketiv.
Veakkatti hava amena ad deganev tarvayyhu vetavach chad umeshayyayr chad, o mezabben chad umeshayyayr chad!

Ella: "shor" desefa vese" deresha meyaytar, denichtov rachamana: "ki yignov ish shor utevacho umecharo, chamishsha vakar yeshallem tachtav, vearba tzon tachat hasse"; "shor" desefa vese" deresha lema li? shema minna: shor vase in, midde acharina la.
En haggonev achar haggannav meshallem tashlume chefel. amar rav: lo shanu ella lifne yeush, aval leachar yeush – kenao gannav rishon, vegannav sheni meshallem tashlume chefel legannav rishon.

Amar rav sheshet: amena ki nayem veshachev rav amar leha shemata. detanya, amar rabbi akiva: mippene ma amra tora tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha? mippene shennishtaresh bachet. emat? illema lifne yeush,

a: Mi ikka nishtaresh? ella leachar yeush. vei salka datach yeush kane, ammay meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha? shello hu toveach, shello hu mocher!
Amri, kidamar rava: mippene sheshshana bachet; hacha name, mippene sheshshana bachet.
Ta shema: "utevacho o mecharo"; ma tevicha – sheenah chozeret, af mechira – sheenah chozeret.
Emat? illema lifne yeush, ammay enah chozeret? ella leachar yeush. vei salka datach kanyeh, ammay meshallem arbaa vachamishsha? shello hu toveach, shello hu mocher!
Kidamar rav nachman: perat leshehikna lishloshim yom, hacha name, perat leshehikna lishloshim yom.
Metivi: ganav uva acher ugenavo – harishon meshallem tashlume chefel, vehashsheni eno meshallem ella keren bilvad.

Ganav umachar, uva acher ugenavo – harishon meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, vehashsheni meshallem tashlume chefel. ganav vetavach, uva acher ugenavo – harishon meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, vehashsheni eno meshallem tashlume chefel, ella keren bilvad.
Katane miha metziata: ganav umachar, uva acher ugenavo – harishon meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, vehashsheni meshallem tashlume chefel.
Emat? illema lifne yeush, sheni ammay meshallem tashlume chefel? shinnuy reshut belo yeush mi ikka leman deamar dekane?
Ella peshita leachar yeush. vei salka datach yeush kone, ammay meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha? dideh hu dezabben!
Vetu, dekatane resha: ganav, uva acher ugenavo – rishon meshallem tashlume chefel, vehashsheni en meshallem ella keren.
Mikkede leachar yeush kayyminan; vei salka datach yeush kone, sheni ammay eno meshallem ella keren? ella lav shema minna yeush la kane, vekashya lerav?

Amar rava: vetisbera ha metaratzta hi?! ella dekatane sefa: ganav vetavach, uva acher ugenavo – rishon meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, vesheni eno meshallem ella keren; umi ikka leman deamar shinnuy maase la kane?

Ella leolam kulla lifne yeush, veefoch sefa limtziata umetziata lesefa, veema hachi: ganav umachar, uva acher ugenavo – harishon meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, vehashsheni eno meshallem ella keren – deshinnuy reshut belo yeush la kane.
Ganav vetavach, uva acher ugenavo – harishon meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, vehashsheni meshallem tashlume chefel; dekanyeh beshinnuy maase.
Rav pappa amar: leolam la tefoch; sefa bet shammay hi, deamri: shinnuy bimkomo omed.
I hachi, kashya resha umetziata lerav!
Amar rav zevid: leolam kulla lifne yeush, vehacha bemay askinan – shennityayashu habbealim belokeach velo nityayashu begannav, dehave leh yeush veshinnuy reshut.
Vela tema mishshum devaenan yeush veshinnuy reshut, ella afillu beyeush lechodeh name kane gabbe gannav;
Ella dela mashkachat dimshallemi tarvayyhu gannav rishon vegannav sheni, ella behachi.
Ittemar: hammocher lifne yeush – rav nachman amar: chayyayv, rav sheshet amar: patur.

Rav nachman amar chayyayv – "umecharo" amar rachamana, veha zabben; la shena lifne yeush, la shena leachar yeush. rav sheshet amar patur – chiyyuveh leachar yeush hu, deahano maasav; aval lifne yeush dela ahano maasav – la michayyayv; duvmya ditvicha baenan, deahano maasav.
Amar rav sheshet: mena amena lah? detanya, amar rabbi akiva: mippene ma amra tora tavach umachar meshallem arbaa vachamishsha? mippene shennishtaresh bachet.
Emat? illema lifne yeush, mi ikka nishtaresh? ella lav leachar yeush hu? amar rava: mippene sheshshana bachet.

Ta shema: "utevacho umecharo"; ma tevicha – sheenah chozeret, af mechira – sheenah chozeret. emat? illema lifne yeush, ammay enah chozeret? ella leachar yeush – ushema minna chiyyuva leachar yeush hu! targema rav nachman: perat leshehikna lo lishloshim yom.
Veaf rabbi elazar savar chiyyuveh leachar yeush hu, deamar rabbi elazar:
b: Teda shessetam geneva yeush bealim hu –
Shehare amra tora: tavach umachar – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. vedilma la iyyayash! ella lav mishshum deamrinan: setam geneva – yeush bealim hi.
Vedilma af al gav dela iyyayash!
Amri: la salka datach; dumeya ditvicha – ma tevicha deahano maasav, af mechira deahano maasav. vei lifne yeush, may ahano?
Vedilma deshamineh deiyyayash! amri: la salka datach; dumeya ditvicha – ma tevicha lealtar, af mechira lealtar.
Amar lo rabbi yochanan: geneva benefesh tochiach – sheen yeush bealim, vechayyayv! mikkelal desavar rabbi yochanan: lifne yeush chayyayv.
Leachar yeush may? rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv, veresh lakish amar: patur.
Rabbi yochanan amar chayyayv – chiyyuveh ben lifne yeush, ben leachar yeush. resh lakish amar patur – chiyyuveh lifne yeush hu, aval leachar yeush – kana, veshello hu toveach veshello hu mocher.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: ganav vehikdish, veachar kach tavach – meshallem tashlume chefel, veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.
Emat? illema lifne yeush, mi kadosh?! "ish ki yakdish et beto kodesh" amar rachamana – ma beto shello, af kol shello!

Ella peshita leachar yeush; vetama dehikdish hu deeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, dechi ka tavach – dehekdesh ka tavach, aval lo hikdish – tavach meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. vei salka datach yeush kone, ammay meshallem? shello hu toveach, shello hu mocher!
Amar leh: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehikdishuhu bealim beyad gannav.
Umi kadosh?! vehaamar rabbi yochanan: gazal velo nityayashu habbealim – shenehen enan yecholin lehakedish, ze lefi sheeno shello, veze lefi sheeno birshuto! amri: hu deamar – kitznuin,
Ditnan: hatztzenuin mannichin et hammaot, veomrim: kol hannilkat mizze, yehe mechullal al hammaot haellu.
Vahare chazra keren labbealim!
Kesheamad baddin.
Hechi dame? i deamri "tze ten lo" – may irya hikdish? afillu lo hikdish name la lichayyeyveh!
Deamar rava: "tze ten lo", tavach umachar – patur. may tama?
Kevan defaskuha lemilleteh vetavach umachar – have leh gazlan, vegazlan eno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.

a: "Chayyayv atta litten lo", tavach umachar – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. may tama? kevan dela pesika milleta, akkatti gannav hu!
La tzericha, deamri leh: "chayyayv atta litten lo".

Gufa, amar rabbi yochanan: gazal velo nityayashu habbealim – shenehem enan yecholim lehakedish. ze lefi sheeno shello, veze lefi sheeno birshuto. umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna;
Utenan: kerem revai hayu metzayyeynin oto bikzuzot adama – simana ki adama, ma adama – ikka hanaa minna, af hay name ki mipparka – shere leithanoye minna.
Veshel orla becharsit – simana kecharsit, ma charsit sheen hanaa minna, af hay delet (beh) hanaa minneh.
Veshel kevarot besid – simana dechivvar kaatzamot. umemache veshofech ki hechi denichavvavr tefe.
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim – bishviit, dehefker ninhu;
Aval bishar shene shavua – haleitehu larasha veyamut.
Vehatztzenuin mannichin et hammaot, veomrim: "kol hannilkat mizze, mechullal al hammaot hallalu"!
Vechi tema: man tena tzenuin – rabban shimon ben gamliel, verabbi yochanan kistam yechidaa la amar;
Vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol makom sheshshana rabban shimon ben gamliel bemishnatenu – halacha kemoto, chutz mearev vetzaydan ureaya acharona!
Amri: la tema "kol hannilkat mizze", ella ema "kol hammitlakket mizze".
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: tzenuin verabbi dosa amru davar echad; verabbi dosa "nilkat" kaamar!
Detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: shacharit – baal habbayit omed veomer: "kol sheyyelakketu aniyyim hayyom, yehe hefker".
Rabbi dosa omer, leittote erev omer: "kol shellaktu aniyyim yehe hefker"!
Efoch derabbi yehuda lerabbi dosa, verabbi dosa lerabbi yehuda. ammay afchat matnita? ifcha lerabbi yochanan, veema: "tzenuin verabbi yehuda amru davar echad"!
Amri: la saggi dela mithafcha matnita; divha matnitin katane deit leh lerabbi yehuda berera, veshaminan leh lerabbi yehuda bealma delet leh berera – ditnan:
b: Hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutim, omer: shene luggin sheani atid lehaferish – hare hen teruma; asara maaser rishon; tisha maaser sheni; umechel veshote miyyad, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin.
Amri: sof sof, ammay ka afchat la lematnitin – mishshum dekashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda; hasheta name – kashya derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan,
Deamrat lerabbi yochanan la tema "kol hannilkat", ella ema "kol hammitlakket" – alma it leh berera; veha rabbi yochanan let leh berera,
Deamar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: haachin shechalku – lakochot hen, umachzirin ze laze bayyovel!
Ella leolam "kol hannilkat",

Verabbi yochanan setama acharina ashkach – ditnan: en haggonev achar haggannav meshallem tashlume chefel. ammay? bishlama legannav rishon la meshallem – "vegunnav mibbet haish", velo mibbet haggannav; ella livalim – neshallem!
Ella lav shema minna: ze lefi sheeno shello, veze lefi sheeno birshuto.
Umay chaze(400) deazel batar hahi setama? lebed ki hay setama ditznuin!
Mishshum dimsayyay leh kera: "veish ki yakdish et beto kodesh laAdonai" – ma beto birshuto, af kol birshuto.
Amar abbaye: i lav deamar rabbi yochanan tzenuin, verabbi dosa amru davar echad, hava amena: tzenuin it lehu derabbi dosa, verabbi dosa let leh ditznuin.

Tzenuin it lehu derabbi dosa – uma begannav avadu rabbanan takkanta, aniyyim tzericha lememar? rabbi dosa let leh ditznuin – aniyyim hu daavadu lehu rabbanan takkanta, aval gannav la avadu lay rabbanan takkanta.
Amar rava, i lav deamar rabbi yochanan: tzenuin verabbi dosa amru davar echad, hava amena: man tena tzenuin – rabbi meir hi;
Lav amar rabbi meir: maaser mamon gavoah hu, vaafillu hachi leinyan pediyyay okmeh rachamana birshuteh? dichtiv: "veim gaol yigal ish mimmaasro, chamishito yosef alav" –
Karyeh rachamana "maasro", umosif chomesh.
Kerem revai name – gamar "kodesh" "kodesh" mimmaaser, ketiv hacha: "kodesh hillulim", uchetiv gabbe maaser: "vechol masar haaretz mizzera haaretz mipperi haetz laAdonai hu kodesh";

Ma "kodesh" dichtiv gabbe maaser – af al gav demamon gavoah hu, leinyan pediyyay okmeh rachamana birshuteh; af hay "kodesh" name dichtiv gabbe kerem revai – af al gav delav mamon dideh hu, leinyan achole okmeh rachamana birshuteh;
Deha ki iteh birshuteh name – ha lav dideh hu, veha matze machel; mishshum hachi matze machel.
Aval gabbe leket – kevan demamona dideh, ki iteh birshuteh hu dematze mafkar leh, ki leteh birshuteh la matze mafkar leh.
Amar ravina: i lav deamar rabbi yochanan tzenuin verabbi dosa amru davar echad, hava amena: man tanna tzenuin – rabbi dosa hi, ki hechi dela tikshe setam mishna lerabbi yochanan. verabbi yochanan –

a: Kistam yechidaa la amar.
Amri nehardae: la katvinan orachta ammittalteli. amar rav ashe leammemar: may tama? amar leh: mishshum derabbi yochanan,
Deamar rabbi yochanan: gazal velo nityayashu habbealim – shenehem enan yecholin lehakedish; ze lefi sheeno shello, veze lefi sheeno birshuto.
Ikka deamri, amri nehardae: la katvinan orachta ammittalteli dechafreh. tama dechafreh, demichaze keshikra; aval la kafreh – katvinan.
Veamri nehardae: orachta dela ketiv beh "zil dun uzechi veappek lenafshach" – let beh meshasha. may tama? mishshum deamar leh haych: lav baal devarim didi at.
Amar abbaye: vei ketiv beh lemechetza lishlish velirvia, miggo demishtae dina appalga, mishtae dina akkulle.
Amar ammemar: i tefas – la mappekinan minneh. rav ashe amar: kevan dechatveh leh "kol demitane min dina kabbelit alay" – shaliach shavveye.
Veikka deamar: shuttafa shavveye. lemay nafka minna? lemitpas palga. vehilcheta: shaliach shavveye.
Mishna ganav al pi shenayim, vetavach umachar al pihem, o al pi shenayim acherim – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.
Ganav umachar beshabbat; ganav umachar laavoda zara; ganav vetavach beyom hakkippurim;
Ganav mishshel aviv vetavach umachar, veachar kach met aviv; ganav vetavach, veachar kach hikdish – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.
Ganav vetavach lirfua o lichlavim; hashshochet venimtzet terefa; hashshochet chullin baazara – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.
Rabbi shimon poter bishne ellu.
Gemara lema matnitin dela kerabbi akiva?
Dei rabbi akiva, haamar: "davar" – velo chatzi davar!
Detanya, amar rabbi yose: keshehalach abba chalafta etzel rabbi yochanan ben nuri lilmod tora, veamri la: rabbi yochanan ben nuri etzel abba
b: Chalafta, amar lo:
Hare sheachalah shana rishona bifne shenayim, sheniyya bifne shenayim, shelishit bifne shenayim, mahu?
Amar lo: hare zo chazaka. amar lo: af ani omer ken, ella sherabbi akiva cholek baddavar. shehaya rabbi akiva omer: "davar" – velo chatzi davar.
Amar abbaye: afillu tema rabbi akiva – mi la mode rabbi akiva bishnayim omrim "kiddesh" ushenayim omrim "baal",
Deaf al gav deede via tzerichi leede kiddushin – kevan deede kiddushin la tzerichi leede via, "davar" karena beh?
Hacha name, af al gav deede tevicha tzerichi leede geneva – kevan deede geneva la tzerichi leede tevicha, "davar" karena beh.
Verabbanan – hay "davar" velo chatzi davar, lemaote may? lemaote echad omer echad begabbah, veechad omer echad bichresah.
Hay chatzi davar vachatzi edut hu!
Ella lemaote shenayim omrim echad begabbah, ushenayim omrim echad bichresah – hane amri ketanna hi, vehane amri ketanna hi.
Ganav umachar beshabbat [vechulei]. vehatanya: patur!
Amar rame bar chama: ki tanya hahi defatur – beomer lo: "akotz lecha teena mitteenati, vetikkene li genevutaych".
Amri: vechevan dechi tava leh kamman bedina la amrinan leh: "zil shallem" – demichayyayv benafsho hu; ha mechira name lav mechira hi!
Ella amar rav pappa, beomer lo: "zerok genevutaych lachatzeri, vetikkene li genevutaych".
Keman? kerabbi akiva, deamar: keluta – kemi shehunnecha damya.
Dei kerabbanan, kevan dematya lachatzar beto – kana, leinyan shabbat – la mechayyayv ad dematya leara!
Beomer: "lo tikkene li genevutaych ad shettanuach".
Rava amar: leolam kerame bar chama; etnan asra tora – vaafillu ba al immo; vei tava leh kamman bedina, mi amrinan leh: "kum hav la etnan"?!

Ella af al gav dechi ka tava leh bedina – la amrinan leh "zil hav lah", kevan dechi yahev la – have etnan; hacha name, af al gav dilinyan tashlumin – i tava [leh] bedina kamman la amrinan leh "zil shallem",

a: Afillu hachi kevan deka makne leh behachi – havya mechira.
Ganav vetavach beyom hakkippurim vechulei. amri: ammay? nehi diktala lekka, malkot miha ikka – vekayyma lan deeno loke umeshallem!
Amri: ha manni – rabbi meir hi, deamar: loke umeshallem.
I rabbi meir, afillu tavach beshabbat! vechi tema: loke umeshallem it leh, met umeshallem let leh;
Vela?! vehatanya: ganav vetavach bashshabbat; ganav vetavach laavoda zara; ganav shor hanniskal utevacho – meshallem arbaa vachamishsha, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim potrin!

Amri: bar minna dehahi, deha ittemar ala: amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi shimon ben lakish, rabbi avin verabbi ila vechol chavurata mishshemeh derabbi yochanan amri: betoveach al yede acher.
Vechi ze chote veze mitchayyev?!
Amar rava: shane hacha, deamar kera: "utevacho umecharo" – ma mechira al yede acher, af tevicha al yede acher.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: "o" – lerabbot et hashshaliach. deve chizkiyya tana: "tachat" – lerabbot et hashshaliach.
Matkef la mar zutera: mi ikka midde deillu aved ihu – la michayyayv, veaved shaliach umichayyayv?
Amar leh rav ashe: hatam lav mishshum dela michayyayv hu, ella dekam leh bidrabba minneh.
Vei betoveach al yede acher, may tama derabbanan defatri?
Amri: man chachamim – rabbi shimon, deamar: shechita sheenah reuya – lo shemah shechita.

Amri: bishlama avoda zara veshor hanniskal – shechita sheenah reuya hi; ella shabbat – shechita reuya hi! ditnan: hashshochet bashshabbat uveyom hakkippurim, af al pi shemmitchayyev benafsho – shechitato keshera!
Amri: savar la kerabbi yochanan hassandelar.
Ditnan: hamevashshel bashshabbat – beshogeg yeachel, bemezid lo yeachel; divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: beshogeg – yeachel bemotzae shabbat, bemezid – lo yeachel olamit.
Rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer: beshogeg – yeachel lemotzae shabbat laacherim, velo lo; bemezid – lo yeachel olamit, lo lo velo laacherim.
May tama derabbi yochanan hassandelar? kiddaresh rabbi chiyyay appitcha deve nesia: "ushemartem et hashshabbat ki kodesh hiv lachem" – ma kodesh asur baachila, af maase shabbat asurin baachila.
I – ma kodesh asur bahanaa, af maase shabbat asur bahanaa?! talmud lomar: "lachem" – shellachem yehe.
Yachol afillu beshogeg? talmud lomar: "mechalleleha mot yumat" – bemezid amarti lecha, velo beshogeg.
Peligi ba rav acha veravina, chad amar: maase shabbat deorayyta, vechad amar: maase shabbat derabbanan.
Man deamar deorayyta – kedaamaran. uman deamar derabbanan – amar kera: "kodesh hu" – hu kodesh, veen maasav kodesh.
Bishlama leman deamar deorayyta, ammetu
b: Lehachi patri rabbanan; ella leman deamar derabbanan, ammay patri rabbanan?
Ashsheara – aavoda zara veshor hanniskal.
Verabbi meir – ammay mechayyev shochet laavoda zara?
Kevan dishchat ba pureta – asra; iddach – issure hanaa hu, vela demaray ka tavach (vela dideh ka tavach)!
Amar rava: beomer bigmar zevicha hu ovdah.
Shor hanniskal – issure hanaa ninhu; lav demareh ka tavach, velav dideh ka tavach!
Amar rava: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shemmesaro leshomer; vehizzik bevet shomer, vehuad bevet shomer, venigmar dino bevet shomer. verabbi meir savar la kerabbi yaakov, vesavar la kerabbi shimon;
Savar la kerabbi yaakov – deamar: af mishshennigmar dino, hechziro shomer labbealim – muchezar.
Vesavar la kerabbi shimon – deamar: davar haggorem lemamon, kemamon dame.
Ditnan, rabbi shimon omer: kodashim shechayyayv beachrayutan – chayyayv; alma davar haggorem lemamon – kemamon dame.

Amar rav kahana, amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea: mi matzet mokmat matnitin kerabbi meir, vela kerabbi shimon? veha katane sefa: rabbi shimon poter bishne ellu; mikkelal divchulla matnitin mode!
Amar leh: la; mikkelal demode betavach umachar lirfua velichlavim.
Ganav mishshel aviv vetavach umachar vechulei. bea minneh rava merav nachman: ganav shor shel shene shuttafin, utevacho, vehoda leechad mehen, mahu?

"Chamishsha bakar" amar rachamana – velo chamishsha chatzae vakar; o dilma, "chamishsha bakar" amar rachamana – vaafillu chamishsha chatzae vakar? amar leh: "chamishsha bakar" amar rachamana – velo chamishsha chatzae vakar.

Etiveh: ganav mishshel aviv, vetavach umachar, veachar kach met aviv – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. veha hacha, kevan demet aviv – kemo shekkadam vehoda leechad mehen dame, vekatane: meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha!
Amar leh: hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheamad aviv baddin.

Aval lo amad baddin, may – eno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha? i hachi, addetane sefa: ganav mishshel aviv, vamet, veachar kach tavach umachar – eno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha; niflog bedideh: bamme devarim amurim – kesheamad baddin, aval lo amad baddin – eno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha!
Amar leh: hachi name; ayyeyde denasev resha: ganav mishshel aviv, vetavach umachar, veachar kach met aviv; nasev sefa name: ganav mishshel aviv, umet aviv, veachar kach tavach umachar.
Letzafra amar leh: "chamishsha bakar" amar rachamana – vaafillu chamishsha chatzae bakar. vehay dela amari lach beureta –

a: Dela achali bisra detora.
Veella may shena resha umay shena sefa?
Amar leh: resha karena beh "utevacho" kullo beissura, sefa la karena bay "utevacho" kullo beissura.
Hashshochet venimtzet terefa vechulei. amar leh rav chavivi machoznaa lerav ashe: shema minna, enah lishchita ella levassof.
Dei yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof, kevan dishchat ba pureta – asra, iddach – la demaray ka tavach!
Amar leh rav huna bereh derava: ki ka michayyayv – ahahu pureta. amar leh rav ashe: la tidchaya[y], "utevacho" kullo baenan – velekka.
Ella kashya! amar leh, hachi amar rav gammada mishshemeh derava: kegon sheshshachat miktzat simanin bachutz, ugemaran bifnim.

Ikka dematne la aha – amar rabbi shimon mishshum derabbi levi sava: enah lishchita ella levassof. verabbi yochanan amar: yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof. amar leh rav chavivi machoznaa lerav ashe, lema kasavar rabbi yochanan: chullin shennishchatu baazara – lav deorayyta?
b: Dei salka datach deorayyta, mikki shachet la pureta – asra, iddach – lav demara ka tavach!
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava: ki ka michayyayv name – ahahu pureta. amar leh rav ashe: la tidchaya, "utevacho" kullo baenan – velekka.
Ella kashya! amar leh, hachi amar rav gammada mishshemeh derava: ki ka mechayyev – kegon sheshshachat miktzat simanin bachutz, ugemaran bifnim.
Mishna ganav al pi shenayim, vetavach umachar al pihen, venimtzeu zommim – meshallemin hakkol.
Ganav al pi shenayim, vetavach umachar al pi shenayim acherim, ellu vaellu nimtzeu zommin – harishonim meshallemin tashlume chefel, veacharonim meshallemin tashlume shelosha.
Nimtzeu acharonim zommin – hu meshallem tashlume chefel, vehen meshallemin tashlume shelosha.
Echad min acharonim zommin – batla edut sheniyya. echad min harishonim zommin – batla kol haedut; sheim en geneva – en tevicha veen mechira.
Gemara ittemar: ed zomem – abbaye amar: lemafrea hu nifsal, rava amar: mikkan ulehabba hu nifsal.
Abbaye amar lemafrea hu nifsal – mehahu shata deashed have leh rasha, vehattora amra: "al tashet rasha ed".
Rava amar mikkan ulehabba hu nifsal – ed zomem chiddush hu; deha tere utere ninhu – may chazet detzayyta[t] lehane? tzeyet lehane!
Hilkach en lecha bo ella mishsheat chiddush veelach.
Ikka deamri: rava name keabbayye sevira leh, deamar lemafrea hu nifsal; vehacha hayeynu tameh derava –

a: Mishshum peseda delakochot.
May benayyhu? deashidu beh tere lechad, utere lechad. i name defaslinhu begazlanuta.
Lehach lishshana deamrat mishshum chiddush – lekka. lehach lishshana deamrat mishshum peseda delakochot – ikka.
Amar rabbi yirmeya middifti: avad rav pappa ovada kevoteh derava. rav ashe amar: hilcheta kevoteh deabbaye. vehilcheta kevoteh deabbaye beyl 143.
Tenan: ganav al pi shenayim, vetavach umachar al pihem, venimtzeu zommin – meshallemin et hakkol.
May, lav sheheidu al haggeneva, vechazru veheidu al hattevicha, vehuzzammu al haggeneva vechazru vehuzzammu al hattevicha?
Vei salka datach lemafrea hu nifsal, hane – kevan deittazzamu lehu aggeneva, iggallay milleta lemafrea dechi ashidu attevicha – pesulin havo; ammay meshallemin attevicha?
Amri: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehuzzammu al hattevicha techilla.
Amri: sof sof, ki hadri mittazzemi aggeneva, iggallay milleta dechi ashidu attevicha – pesulin havo; ammay meshallemi attevicha?
Vehilcheta: sheheidu bevat achat, vehuzzammu.
Lema ketannae: hayu shenayim meidin oto shegganav, vehen meidin oto shettavach, vehuzzammu al haggeneva – edut shebbatla miktzatah, batla kullah.
Huzzammu al hattevicha – hu meshallem tashlume chefel, vehen meshallemin tashlume shelosha.
Amar rabbi yose: bamme devarim amurim – bishte ediyyot, aval beedut achat – edut shebbatla miktzatah, batla kullah.
May "bishte ediyyot", umay "beedut achat"? ilema "bishte ediyyot" – bishte ediyyot mammash, bishte kittot; "beedut achat" – bechat achat beze achar ze;

Veamar rabbi yose: beedut achat – bechat achat beze achar ze, ki mashadi aggeneva vahadar mashadi attevicha, ki mittazzemi attevicha – edut shebbatla miktzatah batla kullah, veittazzamu lehu aggeneva; mehecha tete hach?
Ella lav "bishte ediyyot" – beedut achat keen shete ediyyot, umay ninhu – kat achat beze achar ze; aval beedut achat bevat achat – lo.
Vesavruha, dechulle alma: toch kede dibbur – kedibbur dame.
May, lav beha kamippalgi – derabbanan savri: mikkan ulehabba hu nifsal, vechevan demehahi shata ka mittazzemi – attevicha deka mittazzemi, ittazzum; aggeneva dela mittazzemi, la ittazzum.
Rabbi yose savar: lemafrea hu nifsal, vechevan demiyyad ki ashidu hu demippasli, i ittazzamu lehu attevicha – ittazzamu lehu name aggeneva, deha toch kede dibbur – kedibbur dame.
Amri: i toch kede dibbur kedibbur dame, dechulle alma lemafrea hu nifsal. ella hacha betoch kede dibbur kedibbur dame ka mippalgi – rabbanan savri: toch kede dibbur
b: Lav kedibbur dame, verabbi yose savar: toch kede dibbur kedibbur dame.
Vesavar rabbi yose: toch kede dibbur kedibbur dame? vehatnan: "hare zo temurat ola, temurat shelamim" – hare zo temurat ola, divre rabbi meir.

Rabbi yose omer: im lechach nitkavvevn mittechilla, hoil vei efshar likrot shene shemot keechad – devarav kayyaymin. veim amar: "temurat ola", venimlach veamar: "temurat shelamim" – hare zo temurat ola.
Vehavenan ba: nimlach – peshita!
Veamar rav pappa: nimlach betoch kede dibbur kaamrinan.

Amri: tere "toch kede dibbur" have – chad kede sheelat talmid lerav, vechad kede sheelat harav letalmid. ki let leh lerabbi yose – kede sheelat talmid lerav "shalom alecha rabbi umori", dinfish; kede sheelat harav letalmid "shalom alecha" – it leh.
Amar rava: edim shehuchechashu ulevassof huzzammu – neheragin. dehachchasha techillat hazamma hi, ella shello nigmera.
Amar rava: mena amena la? detanya: "meidani beish peloni shessimme et en avdo vehippil et shinno" – shehare harav omer ken; venimtzeu zommin – meshallemin deme ayin laeved.
Hechi dame? illema kidkatane, delekka kat acharina; meshallemin deme ayin laeved?! batar demappeki leh lecherut – deme eno kavae shallome?
Veod, deme kulleh eved lerav bae leshallome! veod, "shehare harav omer ken" – harav mi nicha leh?

Ella lav kegon daato be tere, veamri: "hippil et shinno, simme et eno" – devae metiv leh harav deme eno; vaato be tere metziae, veamri: "eno, vahadar shinno" – dela bae lemittav leh ella deme shinno, deka machchashi leh kammae limtziae.
Vehayeynu "shehare harav omer ken" – denicha leh bemay dekaamri.
Vekatane: "venimtzeu zommin" – metziae, "meshallemin deme ayin laeved".
Shema minna: hachechasha – techillat hazamma hi!
Amar abbaye: la,
Deafchinhu veazzeminhu.
Mimmay?

a: Middesefa bemefach vahazamma, resha name bemefach vahazamma.
Dekatane sefa: "meidanu et ish peloni shehippil et shen avdo, vesimme et eno" – shehare haeved omer ken; venimtzeu zommin – meshallemin deme ayin larav.
Hechi dame? i dela ka modu lehu batrae bechavla kelal, deme kulleh eved lerav bae shallome leh!
Ella peshita – deka modu kullehu bechavla,
(Udeka afchinan) [udeafchinhu] veazzeminhu.
Vehechi dame? i deka meachari achore hane batrae – akkatti deme eved lerav bae shallome;
Dechi mechayyeyvi leh legavra – akkatti gavra lav bar chiyyuva hu! ella deka mekaddemi kaddome hane batrae.
Vei dela amad baddin – akkatti deme kulleh eved lerav bae shallome leh, deakkatti gavra la michayyayv!
Ella deamad baddin.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav ika lerav ashe: dukeya derava mehecha? illema meresha, resha mi ka mittachchashi metziae?
Kevan dei la mittazzemi – sahaduta kevotayyhu ka kayyma, dedina kevotayyhu paskinan, deyesh bichlal matayim mane;
Hilkach kammae hu deka mittachchashi, metziae la mittachchashi midde!
Amar leh, rava savar: midderesha beshalosh kittot – sefa name beshalosh; vedayek missefa –
Kegon deatu be tere, veamri: "hippil et shinno vesimme eno", ufaskineh ledina appummayyhu;
Veatu be tere acharine, veamri: "simme et eno vehippil et shinno", deka machchashi lehu lehane kammae; venimtzeu zommin kammae – meshallemin deme ayin lerav.
Vei salka datach hachechasha lav techillat hazama hi, ammay meshallemi? ha ittachchashu lehu meikkara! ella shema minna, hachechasha – techillat hazama hi.
Veabbayye amar lach: bishlama resha – la saggi dela shalosh kittot, shehare katane "harav omer ken";
Ella sefa – lema li shalosh kittot? "shehare haeved omer ken"?!
Eved – kol dehu memar amar, denicha leh denippok lecherut.
Matkef la rabbi zera, ema: simme et eno –
b: Nippok beeno; hippil et shinno – nippok beshinno; simme et eno vehippil et shinno – nippok beeno veshinno!
Amar abbaye, alecha amar kera: "tachat eno" – velo tachat eno veshinno, "tachat shinno" – velo tachat shinno veeno.
Amar rav idi bar avin, af anan name tenena: ganav al pi shenayim, vetavach umachar al pihem, venimtzeu zommin – meshallemin lo et hakkol.
May, lav deheidu al haggeneva vechazru veheidu al hattevicha, vehuzzammu al haggeneva vechazru vehuzzammu al hattevicha?

Veha kevan shehuzzammu al haggeneva – legabbe tevicha havu lehu muchechashin, vekatane: meshallemin lo et hakkol. vei salka datach hachechasha lav techillat hazama hi, attevicha ammay meshallemin? ella lav shema minna hachechasha techillat hazama hi?
Amri: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehuzzammu al hattevicha techilla,
Uviflugeta: edim shehuchechashu ulevassof huzzammu – rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar, chad amar: neheragin, vechad amar: en neheragin.
Tistayyem derabbi elazar hu deamar en neheragin – deamar rabbi elazar: edim shehuchechashu benefesh – lokin.
Vei salka datach rabbi elazar hu deamar neheragin – ammay lokin? have leh lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din, vechol lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din – en lokin alav!
Ella lav shema minna, rabbi elazar hu deamar en neheragin? tistayyaym.
Lokin?! tere utere ninhu, may chazet desamchat ahane? semoch ahane!
Amar abbaye: beva harug beraglav.
Mishna ganav al pi shenayim, vetavach umachar al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo – meshallem tashlume chefel, veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.

Ganav vetavach bashshabbat; ganav vetavach laavoda zara; ganav mishshel aviv, umet aviv, veachar kach tavach umachar; ganav vehikdish, veachar kach tavach umachar – meshallem tashlume chefel, veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.
Rabbi shimon omer: kodashim – shechayyayv beachrayutam, meshallem. tashlume arbaa vachamishsha – sheen chayyayv beachrayutam, patur.
Gemara al pi ed echad – peshita!
Amri: ha ka mashma lan, al pi atzmo – dumeya deal pi ed echad; ma al pi [ed] echad – ki ate ed echad mitztaref bahadeh, michayyayv; al pi atzmo name – ki atu edim, michayyayv.
Leappoke midderav huna amar rav – deamar rav huna amar rav: mode biknas, veachar kach bau edim – patur.
Gufa – amar rav huna amar rav: mode biknas, veachar kach bau edim – patur. etiveh rav chisda lerav huna: maase berabban gamliel shessimme et en tavi avdo, vehaya sameach simcha gedola.
Metzao lerabbi yehoshua, amar lo: "i atta yodea shettavi avdi yatza lecherut?" amar lo: "lamma?" amar lo: "shessimmiti et eno". amar lo: "en bidvarecha kelum, shekkevar en lo edim".
Ha yesh lo edim – chayyayv, veshaminan minna: mode biknas, veachar kach bau edim – chayyayv!
Amar leh: shane rabban gamliel, dela bifne bet din odi. veha rabbi yehoshua av bet din hava!

a: Shello bevet din hava kae.
Vehatanya, amar lo: en bidvarecha kelum, shekkevar hodita,

May, lav tannae hi – hay tanna deamar "shekkevar en lecha edim", savar: mode biknas veachar kach bau edim – chayyayv; vehay tanna deamar "shekkevar hodita", savar: mode biknas veachar kach bau edim – patur?

La; dechulle alma, mode biknas veachar kach bau edim – patur; uveha kamippalgi – hay tanna deamar "shekkevar en lecha edim", savar: chutz levet din hava. vehach tanna deamar "shekkevar hodita", savar: bevet din hava.
Ittemar: mode biknas, veachar kach bau edim – rav amar: patur, ushemuel amar: chayyayv.
Amar rava bar ahilay: may tama derav? "im himmatze" – beedim, "timmatze" – bedayyaynin; perat lemarshia et atzmo.
Lema li? measher yarshiun" nafka! ella shema minna, mode biknas veachar kach bau edim – patur!
Ushemuel amar lach: hahu mibbee leh legannav atzmo, kidtana deve chizkiyya.
Etiveh rav lishmuel: raa edim shemmemashmeshim uvaim, veamar: "ganavti, aval lo tavachti velo macharti" – eno meshallem ella keren! amar leh: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shechazru edim laachorehem.
Veha middetane sefa, rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: yavou edim veyaidu; mikkelal detanna kamma savar: la!
Amar leh shemuel: lav ikka rabbi elazar berabbi shimon dekae kevoti? ana daamari – kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon.
Lishmuel vadday tannae hi; lerav mi lema tannae hi?

Amar lecha rav: ana daamari – afillu lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon; ad kan la kaamar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hatam, ella mishshum deka mode mechamat biatuta deedim; aval hacha, demode meatzmo – afillu rabbi elazar berabbi shimon mode.
Amar rav hamenuna: mistabbera milleteh derav beomer "ganavti", uvau edim shegganav – patur, shehare chiyyev atzmo bekeren.
Aval amar "lo ganavti", uvau edim shegganav, vechazar veamar "tavachti umacharti", uvau edim shettavach umachar – chayyayv, shehare patar atzmo mikkelum.
Amar rava: kappachtinhu lesave deve rav. deha rabban gamliel poter atzmo mikkelum hava, vekaamar leh rav chisda lerav huna – vela ka meshanne leh.

Ittemar name, amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: "ganavti", uvau edim shegganav – patur, shehare chiyyev atzmo bekeren. aval amar "lo ganav[ti]", uvau edim shegganav, vechazar veamar "tavachti umacharti", uvau edim shettavach umachar – chayyayv, shehare patar atzmo mikkelum.

Amar rav ashe: matnitin uvarayyta name dayka; matnitin – ditnan: ganav al pi shenayim, vetavach umachar al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo – meshallem tashlume chefel, veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.
Lema li detane ganav al pi shenayim? litne: ganav vetavach [umachar] al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo – eno meshallem ella hakkeren!
b: Ella lav ha ka mashma lan: ganav al pi shenayim vetavach al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo – hu dela mechayyev atzmo bekeren,
Hu deamrinan al pi atzmo dumeya deal pi ed echad; ma al pi ed echad – ki ate ed echad mitztaref bahadeh, michayyayv; al pi atzmo name – ki atu edim, michayyayv.
Aval ganav vetavach umachar al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo – dechiyyev atzmo bekeren, la amrinan al pi atzmo duvmya deal pi ed echad.

Barayyta – detanya: raa edim shemmemashmeshin uvain, veamar: "ganavti, aval lo tavachti velo macharti" – eno meshallem ella keren. lema li lemitne: "veamar ganavti aval lo tavachti velo macharti"? nitne: "o ganavti o tavachti umacharti"!

Ella ha ka mashma lan: tama deamar "ganavti" hu dechiyyev atzmo bekeren – defatur; aval amar "lo ganavti" uvau edim shegganav, vechazar veamar "tavachti umacharti" uvau edim shettavach umachar, delo chiyyev atzmo bekeren – chayyayv. alma hodaa ditvicha lav hodaa hi!
Amri: la, hi gufa ka mashma lan – dechevan deamar: "ganavti"; af al gav deamar "lo tavachti velo macharti", uvau edim shettavach umachar – patur. may tama?
Tashlume (arba) chamishsha amar rachamana, velo tashlume arbaa velo tashlume shelosha.
Lema ketannae – hayu shenayim meidin shegganav, vehayu shenayim meidim oto shettavach umachar; huzzammu ede geneva – edut shebbatla miktzatah batla kullah.

Huzzammu ede tevicha – hu meshallem tashlume chefel, vehen meshallemin tashlume shelosha. mishshum somchos amru: hen meshallemin tashlume chefel, vehu meshallem tashlume shelosha lappar ushenayim laayil.
Aheyay kae somchos? illema aresha – let leh lesomchos edut shebbatla miktzatah batla kullah?
Veella assefa – shappir kaamri rabbanan: hu meshallem tashlume chefel, vehem meshallemin tashlume shelosha!

Ella milleta achariti ikka benayyhu – kegon deatu be tere amri leh "ganavta"; amar lehu: "in, ganavti vetavachti umacharti, mihu lo bifnechem ganavti", veayyti sahadi veazzeminhu – dela beappayyhu genav; veayyti baal habbayit sahade veashidu beh deganav vetavach umachar.
Uvehodaat tevicha kamippalgi –
Derabbanan savri: af al gav dehodaa digneva mechamat edim hu deka mode, hodaa ditvicha hodaa hi, ufatur.
Vesomchos savar: kevan dehodaa digneva mechamat edim hu deka mode, ditvicha lav hodaa.
Vehanach edim kammae deazzeminhu – meshallemin tashlume chefel; vehu meshallem shelosha lappar ushenayim laayil.
Amar rav acha bereh derav ika: la; dechulle alma – hodaa ditvicha lav hodaa hi;

Ella beedut shei atta yachol lahazimmah kamippalgi – kegon deatu sahade veamri leh: "ganavta", veamar lehu: "ganavti vetavachti umacharti, mihu lo bifnechem ganavti ella bifne peloni ufeloni"; veayyti sahadi veazzeminhu – dela beappayyhu genav; vaato peloni ufeloni veashidu beh deganav vetavach umachar.
Uveha kamippalgi – derabbanan savri havya la edut shei atta yachol lahazimmah, vechol edut shei atta yachol lahazimmah – la havya edut.
Vesomchos savar: edut shei atta yachol lahazimmah – havya edut.
Veha kayyma lan deedut shei atta yachol lahazimmah la havya edut! hane mille hecha dela yadi beeze yom beeze shaa – delekka leedut kelal; aval hacha – sayyoe hu deka mesayyeyi leh.
Amar mar: hen meshallemin tashlume chefel. middeka mode dignav – keren bae shallome?! amar rabbi elazar mishshemeh derav, teni:

a: Tashlum dechefel.
Ganav vehikdish veachar kach tavach umachar kulei. amri: bishlama attevicha la michayyayv, dechi ka tavach – dehekdesh ka tavach, vela demareh ka tavach;
Ella ahekdesh – lichayyayv! ma li mecharo lehedyot, ma li mecharo lashshamayim?
Ha manni – rabbi shimon hi, deamar: kodashim shechayyayv beachrayutan – birshuteh demareh kayymi.
Ha middesefa rabbi shimon have, resha lav rabbi shimon!
Ella hacha bemay askinan – bekadashim kallim, veallibba derabbi yose haggelili, deamar: kadashim kallim – mamon bealim hu, uvirshuteh kayymi.
Aval kodshe kadashim may, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha?! addetane resha: ganav vetavach veachar kach hikdish – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha; liflog velitne bedida:
Bamme devarim amurim – bekadashim kallim, aval bekodshe kodashim – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha!

Ella leolam – la shena kodshe kadashim, vela shena kadashim kallim; udekashya lach: ma li mecharo lehedyot ma li mecharo lashshamayim; mecharo lehedyot – meikkara tora diruven, vehasheta tora deshimon. mecharo lashshamayim – meikkara tora diruven, vehasheta tora diruven.
Rabbi shimon omer vechulei. amri, nehi desavar rabbi shimon: ma li mecharo lehedyot ma li mecharo lashshamayim; ippecha mibbee leh:
Kodashim shechayyayv beachrayutan – patur, deakkatti la nefak mershuteh;
Kodashim sheeno chayyayv beachrayutan – chayyayv, demappeki leh mershuteh!
Amri: rabbi shimon – ammilleta achariti kae,
Vehachi katane: en haggonev achar haggannav meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, vechen gonev hekdesh mibbet bealim – patur.
May tama? "vegunnav mibbet haish" – velo mibbet hekdesh.
Rabbi shimon omer: kodashim shechayyayv beachrayutan – chayyayv. may tama? karena beh: "vegunnav mibbet haish". vesheeno chayyayv beachrayutan – patur, dela karenan beh: "vegunnav mibbet haish".
Mikkedi shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar: shechita sheenah reuya – lo shemah shechita; kodashim name shechita sheenah reuya hi!
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: beshochet temimim mibbifnim leshem bealim.
Vahare chazra keren labbealim! amar rabbi yitzchak bar avin: shennishpach haddam.
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: beshochet temimim bifnim shello leshem bealim.
b: Veresh lakish amar: beshochet baale mumin bachutz.
Tahe ba rabbi elazar: lerabbi yochanan – shechita matteret?! vahalo zerika matteret!
Leresh lakish – shechita matteret?! vahalo pediyyay matteret!
Ishtemitteh ha derabbi shimon: kol haomed lizrok – kezaruk dame, vechol haomed lifdot – kefaduy dame.
Kol haomed lizrok kezaruk dame – detanya, rabbi shimon omer: yesh notar shehu metamme tumeat ochalin, veyesh notar sheeno metamme tumeat ochalin.
Ketzad? lan lifne zerika – eno metamme tumeat ochalin. leachar zerika – metamme tumeat ochalin.
Vekayyma lan: may "lifne zerika" – kodem shennira lizrika. "leachar zerika" – leachar shennira lizrika.
Kodem shennira lizrika lan – may hi? dela havya shehut bayyom lemizrekeh, deshachteh samuch lishkiat hachamma – veeno metamme tumeat ochalin.
Leachar shennira lizrika lan, dahavay shehut bayyom lemizrekeh – metamme tumeat ochalin. alma kol haomed lizrok – kezaruk dame,
Vechol haomed lifdot – kefaduy dame. detanya, rabbi shimon omer:

a: Para – metamme tumeat ochalin, hoil vehayta lah sheat hakkosher.
b: Veamar resh lakish, omer haya rabbi shimon: para nifdet al gabbe maarachtah. alma kol haomed lifdot – kefaduy dame.
Bishlama rabbi yochanan la amar kerabbi shimon ben lakish – deka bae leokoma lematnitin afillu bitmimin. ella resh lakish – may tama la amar kerabbi yochanan?

Amar lach: "utevacho umecharo" – kol hecha deiteh bimchira iteh bitvicha, vechol hecha deleteh bimchira leteh bitvicha. vehane kodashim – hoil dechi mezabben kodashim la havya mechira, letanhu bitvicha.
Veazdu letamayyhu – deittemar: hammocher terefa ledivre rabbi shimon – rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv, veresh lakish amar: patur.
Rabbi yochanan amar chayyayv – af al gav deleteh bitvicha, iteh bimchira. veresh lakish amar patur – kevan deleteh bitvicha, leteh bimchira.

Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish: ganav kilayim utevachah, terefa umecharah – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. may, lav rabbi shimon hi? alma af al gav deleteh bitvicha – iteh bimchira!
Amar leh: la; rabbanan.
I rabbanan, terefa bimchira ita – bizvicha leta?!
Veella may, rabbi shimon?! kilayim bitvicha ita, bimchira leta?!
Ella tena tevicha – vehu haddin limchira; ema lerabbanan name, tena mechira – vehu haddin litvicha.
Verabbi yochanan amar lach: hay may? i amrat bishlama rabbi shimon, ayyeyde ditna terefa bachada – tena kilayim bachada.
Ella i amrat rabbanan, nearvinhu venitninhu: ganav kilayim uterefa, tevachan umecharan – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha! kashya.
Kilayim – "se" ketiv; veamar rava: ze bana av – kol makom shenneemar "se", eno ella lehotzi et hakkilayim!
Shane hacha, deamar kera: "o" – lerabbot et hakkilayim.
Vechol "o" lerabbot hu? vehatanya: "shor o chesev" – perat lechilayim, "o ez" – perat lenidme!

Amar rava: hacha meinyayneh dikra, vehacha meinyayneh dikra. hacha gabbe geneva, dichtiv: "shor o se", shei atta yachol lehotzi kilayim mibbenehem – "o" lerabbot kilayim. gabbe kodashim, dichtiv: "kesev vaez", sheatta yachol lehotzi kilayim mibbenehem – "o" lemaet hu.

a: Ha gabbe kodashim name neemar: "shor o chesev" – sheen atta yachol lehotzi kilayim mibbenehem, unerabbe! middesefa lemaet, resha name lemaet. adderabba; midderesha lerabbot, sefa name lerabbot!

Hay may? i amrat bishlama lemaet – hu deitzterich tere miute; deaf al gav deimmaat kilayim, itzterich lemaote nidme. ella i amrat lerabbot – tere ribbuye lema? hasheta kilayim irabbi leh, nidme mibbaya?!
Ella ha deamar rava: ze bana av – kol makom shenneemar "se", eno ella lehotzi et hakkilayim; lemay hilcheta? i lekadashim, behedya ketiv behu "shor o chesev" – perat lechilayim!
I lemaaser, "tachat"–"tachat" yalef, mikkodashim!
I livchor, "haavara"–"haavara" yalef, mimmaaser!
I name, nidme amrat la – dichtiv: "ach bechor shor" – ad sheyyehe hu shor uvechoro shor; kilayim mibbaya?
Ella ki ittemar derava – leinyan peter chamor. keditnan: en podin lo beegel velo bechayya velo bishchuta velo bitrefa velo bechilayim velo bechoy.
Ulerabbi elazar demattir bechilayim – ditnan: rabbi elazar mattir bechilayim mippene shehu se, lemay hilcheta?

Amar lach rabbi elazar: ki ittemar derava – letame shennolad min hattahor veibburo min hattame, udela kerabbi yehoshua; dei rabbi yehoshua, misse chesavim vese izzim" nafka leh – ad sheyyehe aviv keves veimmo kivsa.
Utehora mittemea mi miabbera?! in; dekayyma lan
b: Deiabbar mikkalut, kerabbi shimon.

Bae rava: "hare alay ola", vehifrish shor, uva acher veganav; mi patar gannav nafsheh becheves – lerabbanan, beolat haof – lerabbi elazar ben azarya? ditnan: "hare alay ola" – yavi keves. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: yavi tor o ben yona.
May? mi amrinan: shem ola kabbel illaveh; o dilma, matze amar leh: ana mitzva min hammuvechar baena lemebad?
Batar deibbaya, hadar pashta: gannav poter atzmo becheves lerabbanan, beolat haof lerabbi elazar ben azarya.
Rav acha bereh derav ika matne la behedya – amar rava: "hare alay ola" vehifrish shor, uva acher ugenavo – poter atzmo becheves lerabbanan, uveolat haof lerabbi elazar ben azarya.

Mishna mecharo chutz meechad mimmea shebbo, o shehayta lo bo shuttafut; hashshochet venitnabbela beyado, hannocher, vehameakker – meshallem tashlume chefel, veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.
Gemara may "chutz meechad mimmea shebbo"? amar rav: chutz middavar hannittar immo bishchita. velevi amar: chutz miggizzoteha. vechen tanya bematnita: chutz miggizzoteha.

Metivi: mecharah chutz miyyadah, chutz meraglah, chutz mikkarnah, chutz miggizzoteha – eno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. rabbi omer: davar hameakkev bishchita – eno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha,
Vesheeno meakkev bishchita – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: chutz mikkarnah – eno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, chutz miggizzoteha – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.
Bishlama lelevi – ketanna kamma; ella lerav – keman?

Amri: rav deamar – ki hay tanna, detanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: mecharah chutz miyyadah vechutz meraglah – eno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. chutz mikkarnah, chutz miggizzoteha – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.
Bemay kamippalgi? tanna kamma savar: "utevacho" kullo baenan, "umecharo" kullo baenan.
Verabbi savar: "utevacho" – midde dehave bitvicha, leappoke midde dela havya bitvicha; "umecharo" – duvmya ditvicha.

Verabbi shimon ben elazar savar: karna, dela lemiggaz kayyma – have shiyyur, veeno meshallem tashlum arbaa vachamishsha; gizzoteha, dilmiggaz kayymi – la have shiyyur, umeshallem tashlum arbaa vachamishsha.

Veiddach tanna deve rabbi shimon ben elazar savar: yadav veraglav, ditzrichi tevicha – have shiyyur, vela meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha; karneha vegizzoteha, dela tzerichi tevicha – la have shiyyur.
Kashya derabbi shimon ben elazar adderabbi shimon ben elazar! tere tannae veallibba derabbi shimon ben elazar.
Tanu rabbanan: haggonev hakkittaat veet hachiggeret veet hassoma, vechen haggonev behemat hashshuttafin – chayyayv. veshuttafim shegganvu – peturim. vehatanya: shuttafin shegganvu – chayyayvin!
Amar rav nachman: la kashya; kan beshuttaf shegganav mechavero, kan beshuttaf shegganav mealma.
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: yachol shuttaf shegganav mechavero, veshuttafim shegganvu, yehu chayyayvin; talmud lomar: "utevacho" kullo baenan – velekka!
Ella amar rav nachman: la kashya; kan beshuttaf shettavach ledaat chavero, kan beshuttaf shettavach shello ledaat chavero.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: mecharah chutz mishsheloshim yom; chutz mimmelachtah; chutz meubbarah; mahu?

Allibba deman deamar ubbar yerech immo hu – la tibbee lach, deha shayyayr ba; ki tibbee lach – allibba deman deamar deubbar lav yerech immo; may? memar amrinan: kevan dimchubbar ba – have shiyyur; o dilma, kevan dilmifrash minna kae, la have shiyyur?
Ikka deamri: kevan delav yerech immo hu – la have shiyyur; o dilma, kevan ditzrich leishteroye bahada bishchita – keman deshayyayr begufa dame? teku.
Bae rav pappa: genavah, ketaah umecharah, mahu? mi amrinan: may dignav – ha la zabben; o dilma, ma dezabben – ha la shayyayr? teku.
Tanu rabbanan: ganav, venatan leacher vetavach; ganav, venatan leacher umachar;

a: Ganav vehikdish; ganav vehikkif; ganav vehechlif; ganav venatan bemattana; ganav ufara chovo; ganav ufara behekkefo; ganav veshalach sivlonot bevet chamiv – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.
May ka mashma lan? ashmeinan resha ganav venatan leacher vetavach – deyesh shaliach lidvar avera. af al gav divchol hattora kullah en shaliach lidvar avera, hacha yesh shaliach lidvar avera.
May tama? "utevacho" umecharo"; ma mechira – dela efshar delav al yede acher, af tevicha al yede acher – michayyayv.
Veashmeinan sefa ganav vehikdish – ma li mecharo lehedyot, ma li mecharo lashshamayim.

Mishna ganav birshut habbealim, vetavach umachar chutz mershutam; o shegganav chutz mershutam, vetavach umachar birshutam; o shegganav vetavach umachar chutz mershutam – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. aval ganav vetavach umachar birshutam – patur.
Haya moshcho veyotze, umet birshut habbealim – patur. higbiho o hotzio mershut bealim, vamet – chayyayv.
Netano livchorot beno o levaal chov, leshomer chinnam, leshoel, lenose sachar ulesocher; vehaya moshcho, umet birshut habbealim – patur. higbiho o shehotzio mershut habbealim, vamet – chayyayv.
Gemara bae ammemar: tikkenu meshicha beshomrim, o lo?

Amar rav yemar, ta shema: netano livchorot beno o levaal chovo, leshomer chinnam uleshoel, lenose sachar ulesocher; haya moshcho veyotze, umet birshut habbealim – patur. may, lav shomer – ushema minna tikkenu meshicha beshomrin?
Amar leh: la, gannav.
Ha tena leh resha! tena gannav shegganav mibbet habbealim, utena gannav shegganav mibbet shomer.
Amar leh rav ashe: la tedachayeh; ma li gannav shegganav mibbet shomer, ma li gannav shegganav mibbet bealim?
Ella lav shomer – ushema minna tikkenu meshicha beshomrin? shema minna. ittemar name, amar rabbi elazar: kederech shettikkenu meshicha belakochot, kach tikkenu meshicha beshomrin.

Tanya name hachi: kederech shettikkenu meshicha belakochot, kach tikkenu meshicha beshomrin. ucheshem shehakkarka niknet bechesef, bishtar uvachazaka, kach sechirut niknet bechesef, bishtar uvachazaka.
Sechirut demay? ilema
b: Sechirut demittaltelin, mittalteli bene shetara ninhu?! amar rav chisda: sechirut dekarka.
Amar rabbi elazar: rauhu shehitmin bachorashin vetavach umachar – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. ammay? ha lo mashach! amar rav chisda: shehikkishah bemakkel.
Amri: vechevan derauhu, gazlan hu! kevan deka mittammaroy minnayyhu, gannav hu.
Veella gazlan hechi dame? amar rabbi avahu: kegon benayahu ben yehoyada, shenneemar: "vayyigzol et hachanit miyyad hammitzri, vayyahargehu bachanito".
Rabbi yochanan amar: kegon baale shechem, shenneemar: "vayyasimu lo vaale shechem mearvim al rashe heharim, vayyigzelu [et] kol asher yaavor alehem baddarech".
Verabbi avahu – may tama la amar mehay? amar lach: kevan demittammeri ittammore, la gazlane ninhu. verabbi yochanan – ha deka mittammeri, dela nichzinhu inashe venireku minnayyhu.
Shaalu talmidav et rabban yochanan ben zakkay: mippene ma hechmira tora begannav yoter miggazlan? amar lahen: ze – hishva kevod eved lichvod kono, veze – lo hishva kevod eved lichvod kono.

Kivyachol asa ayin shel matta keillu enah roa, veozen shel matta keillu enah shomaat, shenneemar: "hoy hammaamikim meAdonai lastir etza, vehaya vemachshach maasehem vegomer"; uchetiv: "vayyomru lo yire yah velo yavin elohe yaakov"; uchetiv: "ki [amru] azav Adonai et haaretz, veen Adonai roe".

Tanya, amar rabbi meir: mashlu mashal mishshum rabban gamliel, lema haddavar dome? lishne bene adam shehayu beir veasu mishte, echad zimmen et bene hair velo zimmen et bene hammelech, veechad lo zimmen et bene hair velo zimmen et bene hammelech. eze mehen onsho merubbe? heve omer: ze shezzimmen et bene hair velo zimmen et bene hammelech.
Amar rabbi meir: bo uree kamma gadol koach shel melacha: shor, shebbittelo mimmelachto – chamishsha; se, shello bittelo mimmelachto – arbaa.
Amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay, bo uree kamma gadol kevod habberiyyot: shor, shehalach beraglav – chamishsha; se, shehirkivo al ketefo – arbaa.
Mishna en megaddelin behema dakka beeretz yisrael; aval megaddelin besureya, uvammidbarot shel eretz yisrael.
En megaddelin tarnegolin birushalayim, mippene hakkodashim; velo kohanim beeretz yisrael, mippene hatteharot.
En megaddelin chazirin – bechol makom. lo yegaddel adam et hakkelev, ella im ken haya kashur beshalshelet. en porsin nishshuvim leyonim, ella im ken haya rachok min hayyishshuv sheloshim ris.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: en megaddelin behema dakka beeretz yisrael, aval megaddelin bachorashin shel eretz yisrael. besureya – afillu bayyishshuv, veen tzarich lomar bechutza laaretz.

Tanya iddach: en megaddelin behema dakka beeretz yisrael; aval megaddelin bammidbar shebbihuda, uvammidbar shebbisfar akko. veaf al pi sheamru en megaddelin behema dakka, aval megaddelin behema gassa; lefi sheen gozrin gezera al hatztzibbur ella im ken rov tzibbur yecholin laamod bah.
Behema dakka efshar lehavi mechutza laaretz, behema gassa i efshar lehavi mechutza laaretz.
Veaf al pi sheamru en megaddelin behema dakka – aval meshahah hu kodem laregel sheloshim yom, vekodem mishte beno sheloshim yom. uvilvad shello yeshahe et haacharona sheloshim yom.
Desalka datach amena dei nefak leh regel, umikki zavna ad hasheta akkatti la melo leh telatin yomin; la nema telatin mishra shere leh leshahoye, ella kevan dinfak leh regel – la mibbee leh leshahoye.

a: Vehattabbach lokeach veshochet, lokeach veshohe – uvilvad shello yeshahe haaguna shebbahen sheloshim yom.
Shaalu talmidav et rabban gamliel: mahu legaddel? amar lahen: muttar. vehatnan: en megaddelin!
Ella hachi ka bau minneh: mahu leshahot? amar lahen: muttar, uvilvad shello tetze vetire baeder; ella koshrah bechare hammitta.

Tanu rabbanan: maase bechasid echad shehaya goneach millibbo, veshaalu larofim, veamru: en lo takkana ad sheyyinak chalav roteach mishshacharit leshacharit. veheviu lo ez vekashru lo bechare hammitta, vehaya yonek mimmenna mishshacharit leshacharit.
Leyamim nichnesu chaverav levakkero, kevan sherau otah haez keshura bechare hammitta – chazru laachorehem, veamru: listim mezuyyayn beveto shel ze, veanu nichnasin etzlo?!
Yashvu uvadku, velo matzu bo ella oto avon shel otah haez. veaf hu bishat mitato amar: yodea ani sheen bi avon ella avon otah haez, sheavarti al divre chaveray.

Amar rabbi yishmael: mibbaale vattim shebbaggalil haelyon hayu bet abba; umippene ma charvu? shehayu marin bachorashin, vedanin dine mamonot beyachid. veaf al pi shehayu lahem chorashim samuch levattehem, sade ketanna hayta umaavirin derech aleha.

Tanu rabbanan: roe sheasa teshuva – en mechayyeyvin oto limkor miyyad, ella mocher al yad al yad. vechen ger shennaflu lo kelavim vachazirim birushshato – en mechayyeyvin oto limkor miyyad, ella mocher al yad al yad.
Vechen mi shennadar likkach bayit velikkach ishsha beeretz yisrael – en mechayyeyvin oto likkach miyyad, ad sheyyimtza et hahogenet lo.

Umaase beishsha achat shehaya benah metzer lah, vekaftza venishbea: "kol mi sheyyavo, eni machzirato", vekaftzu aleha bene adam sheenan mehugganin. ucheshebba haddavar etzel chachamim, amru: lo nitkavvevna zo ella lehagun lah.

Keshem sheamru en megaddelin behema dakka, kach amru en megaddelin chayya dakka. rabbi yishmael omer: megaddelin kelavim kuferin, vachatulim, vekofin, vechuledot senaim – mippene sheasuyim lenakker et habbayit.
May chuledot senaim? amar rav yehuda: shirtza chartza. veikka deamri: charza – dekattine shakay, veraaya bene vavrdine. umay shirtza? demittattiy shakay.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: asinu atzmenu bevavel keeretz yisrael livhema dakka. amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerav huna: didach may?

Amar leh: didan ka meynattera lehu chubba. amar leh: chubba tikberinhu livna. kullehu sheneh derav adda bar ahava la ikkayyaym zara lerav huna mechubba. ikka deamri, amar rav huna amar rav: asinu atzmenu bevavel keeretz yisrael livhema dakka, mikki ata rav levavel.
Rav ushemuel verav assi ikkelau leve shevua habben, veamri la leve yeshua habben. rav la ayel kammeh dishmuel,
b: Shemuel la ayel kammeh derav assi, rav assi la ayel kammeh derav. amri: man nittarach? nittarach shemuel venete rav verav assi.
Venittarach rav o rav assi! rav – milleta bealma hu daavad leh lishmuel; mishshum hahu maase delatyeh, adbereh rav aleh.
Addehachi vehachi, ata shunara kateh lida deyanoka. nefak rav uderash: chatul – muttar lehorgo, veasur lekayyeymo, veen bo mishshum gazel, veen bo mishshum hashev aveda labbealim.
Vechevan deamrat "muttar lehorgo", may nihu tu "asur lekayyeymo"? mahu detema: muttar lehorgo, issura lekka; ka mashma lan.
Amri: vechevan deamrat "en bo mishshum gazel", may nihu tu "en bo mishshum hashev aveda labbealim"? amar ravina: leoro.
Metivi, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: megaddelin kelavim kuferin, vachatulin, vekofin, vechuledot senaim – mippene sheasuyin lenakker et habbayit! la kashya; ha beukkama, ha bechiuora.
Veha maase derav – ukkama hava! hatam – ukkama bar chivvara hava. veha mivay bae leh ravina!
Devae ravina: ukkama bar chivvara, mahu? ki kamibbaya leh leravina – beukkama bar chivvara bar ukkama; maase derav – beukkama bar chivvara bar chivvara hava.

(14 20 60 – Siman.) amar rabbi acha bar pappa mishshum rabbi abba bar pappa mishshum rabbi adda bar pappa, veamri la: amar rabbi abba bar pappa mishshum rabbi chiyyay bar pappa mishshum rabbi acha bar pappa, veamri la: amar rabbi abba bar pappa mishshum rabbi acha bar pappa mishshum rabbi chanina bar pappa:
Matriin al hachikkuch beshabbat, vedelet hanninelet lo bimhera tippatach, vehallokeach bayit beeretz yisrael – kotvin alav ono afillu beshabbat.
Metivi: ushear pureaniyyot hammitraggeshot uvaot al hatztzibbur – kegon chikkuch, chagav, zevuv, tzira veyattush, veshilluach nechashim veakrabbim – lo hayu matriin, ella tzoakim!

La kashya; kan belach, kan beyavesh. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: shechin shehevi hakkadosh baruch hu al hammitzrim – lach mibbachutz veyavesh mibbifnim, shenneemar: "vayhi shechin avabuot poreach baadam uvabbehema".

"Vedelet hanninelet lo bimhera tippatach", may hi? mar zutera amar: semicha. rav ashe amar: kol hammeriin lo, lo bimhera metivin lo. rav acha middifti amar: leolam en metivin lo. vela hi, rav acha middifti milleta denafsheh hu deamar.
Vehallokeach bayit beeretz yisrael – kotvin alav ono afillu beshabbat. beshabbat salka datach?!
Ella kidamar rava hatam: omer legoy veose; hachi name, omer legoy veose. veaf al gav daamira legoy shevut hi, mishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael la gezaru beh rabbanan.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: hallokeach ir beeretz yisrael, kofin oto likkach lah derech mearba ruchoteha, mishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael.
Tanu rabbanan, asara tenain hitna yehoshua:

a: Sheyyehu marin bachorashin; umelakketin etzim bisdotehem; umelakketim asavim bechol makom – chutz mittiltan; vekotmim netiot bechol makom – chutz miggerofiyyot shel zayit; umayan hayyotze battechilla – bene hair mistappekin mimmennu; umechakkin beyammah shel teverya, uvilvad shello yifros kela veyaamid et hassefina;

Venifnin laachore haggader, vaafillu besade melea karkom; umehallechim bishvile harshut, ad shettered revia sheniyya; umistallekin letzidde hadderachim mippene yetedot hadderachim; vehattoe ben hakkeramim – mefasseg veole mefasseg veyored; umet mitzva kone mekomo.
Sheyyehu marin bachorashin. amar rav pappa: la amaran ella dakka begassa, aval dakka bedakka vegassa begassa – la. vechol shekken gassa bedakka dela.
